fullDescription: The S32 design system is a sophisticated dark-mode UI tailored for high-stakes operational environments, monitoring dashboards, and intelligence platforms. It features a tactical deep-navy and charcoal palette (#080A0D, #0B0E12) punctuated by high-contrast functional accents: vibrant blue (#3B82F6) for systems, amber (#F59E0B) for warnings, red (#EF4444) for critical incidents, and emerald green (#10B981) for verified safety. The typography utilizes a professional pairing of 'Inter' for UI elements and 'JetBrains Mono' for technical telemetry and data points. Key visual traits include isometric grid systems, scanning line animations, glow-filtered SVG paths, and modular bento-style product entries. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, cybersecurity platforms, fintech risk monitoring, and real-time logistics systems.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-fidelity tactical intelligence dashboard interface in deep dark mode. The design emphasizes data veracity and situational awareness through a hierarchy of corroborated signals. It uses a clean, utilitarian aesthetic with sharp borders, subtle glow effects, and a mix of sans-serif and monospace typography to convey precision and technical reliability.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with the following specs:
- **Color Palette**: Backgrounds: Base `#080A0D`, Panels `#0B0E12`. Borders: Subtle `#1A1D23`. Accents: Primary Blue `#3B82F6`, Warning Amber `#F59E0B`, Critical Red `#EF4444`, Success Green `#10B981`. Text: Heading `#E2E8F0`, Muted `#94A3B8`, Sub-muted `#64748B`.
- **Typography**: Primary Font: 'Inter' (sans-serif). Secondary Font: 'JetBrains Mono' (monospace) for timestamps, IDs, and confidence scores. Font Weights: Bold (700) for hero headlines, Semibold (600) for section titles, Medium (500) for navigation, Regular (400) for body copy.
- **Effects**: Box shadows using `shadow-2xl` with subtle colored glows (`shadow-blue-500/5`). Use a 'scan-line' overlay: a 2px horizontal gradient (transparent, `#3B82F6`, transparent) animating vertically over 8s.
- **Borders/Corners**: Use sharp or slightly rounded corners (`rounded-sm` or `rounded-lg`). Horizontal separators and container borders should be 1px solid `#1A1D23`.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
A fixed-height (14rem) sticky header with a bottom border (`#1A1D23`). Left: Logo mark (6x6 blue square with 'S32' text) and uppercase 14px SEMIBOLD navigation links. Right: 'Request Access' button in high-contrast white background with black text.

### Hero Section
Center-aligned hero with a 60px bold headline and 18px slate-gray subtext. Below the text, feature an 'Isometric Map Container': a 21:9 aspect ratio window with a dark map background. Include floating data cards: a 'Live Incident' card on the left with a red pulsing icon and a 91% progress bar; a 'Telemetry Feed' on the right with vertical chronological log entries. Apply a vertical scanning line animation across the entire map area.

### Visual Comparison Grid
A two-column grid titled 'One signal is not enough.' Column 1 (Unverified): A dark card with low-confidence amber badges and a dashed empty evidence area. Column 2 (Corroborated): A highlighted card with a blue border, high-confidence green badges, and a 2x2 grid of icon-led data modules (Sensors, CCTV, Reports, Official Signal).

### Intelligence Timeline
A centered vertical timeline. Each entry consists of a 12px monospace timestamp on the left and a content block on the right. Content blocks include a bold source title (e.g., 'RAIN SENSOR ARRAY') followed by a 14px description of the observation and the resulting confidence score.

### Explore Platform Modules
A 4-column bento-style grid. Each module is a clickable card with a 1px border. Elements per card: 24px Lucide-style icon, 14px semibold title, and 11px leading-relaxed description. Hover state: Border changes to blue and title text color shifts.

### Final CTA & Footer
CTA: Centered 36px bold text with a 100px vertical blue gradient overlay. Two large action buttons: 'Get Started' (solid blue) and 'Talk to Expert' (outlined). Footer: Low-profile with system logo on the left and a monospace 'Current System Time' display in UTC on the right.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Operational Status Badge — A high-visibility status indicator for real-time monitoring.
Create a status badge component: Monospace text, 9px-10px size, uppercase. Background: 10% opacity of accent color. Border: 20% opacity of accent color. Text: 100% opacity of accent color. Example: Green badge with '91% HIGH CONFIDENCE' or 'SYNCHRONIZED'.

### Incident Overlay Card — Floating glassmorphism-style info cards found in the hero map.
Design a floating card: Background `#080A0D` at 90% opacity, backdrop-blur 10px. Padding 16px. Top-right corner displays a system ID in 8px gray monospace. Include a horizontal progress bar for 'Confidence' using a 4px height background track and a full-intensity accent color fill.

style.description: Tactical Dark Mode Style: Deep black-blue base (#080A0D) with subtle panel variations (#0B0E12). Border-driven architecture using #1A1D23. Typography combines 'Inter' (300-700 weight) for readability with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data. Functional color logic: Blue=Info, Red=Critical, Green=Success, Amber=Warning. Animations include a global 8s linear scan-line and pulsing status indicators.
